explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 980 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA inspection 985599 at Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 2618677) ended on 2016-10-03 and was classified OAI, 980 days before FDA posted the potassium chloride shortage on 2019-06-10.
Additional OAI classifications at the same plant occurred in 2010, 2013, 2014, and 2015, with a VAI inspection in 2018 and another VAI in 2024.
A second Baxter plant (FEI 1416980) received an OAI classification in 2024 and another in 2026, followed by a Warning Letter on 2026-09-29.
Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) received an OAI classification in 2019 and a Warning Letter in 2020.
Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) had multiple OAI inspections between 2010 and 2011, with a Warning Letter in 2010.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 88 months.
The rule-selected alternate manufacturer is A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.

Q-af6f09.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%potassium%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%potassium%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-07e9e2.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('efef4846-9497-41af-8dd6-518f86eca7f2', 'ab67b151-8368-4321-b562-bad5eff7b740', '092ddee4-572d-4771-8d95-880cea01097e', '8123cce8-42e3-49e4-a488-3bb836ecccd0', '91950983-4884-40d1-abd8-bcc953d61b7f', '31366b4b-dfd6-4fda-babe-2cb3d2c14a2b', 'd43beabe-b801-4319-ad36-9a80856b94bd', '30144e2e-d336-8fa3-e063-6394a90a6068', '559a0a8c-a8fe-40a5-b196-21f9308780ab') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-6c213f.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%potassium%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-12b270.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%potassium%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-3d3532.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%potassium%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%powder%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-b8544d.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1416980', '2649614', '2618677', '3003294404', '3011895410', '3004021229', '1021343', '3008316085', '1810189') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-341a7f.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1416980', '2649614', '2618677', '3003294404', '3011895410', '3004021229', '1021343', '3008316085', '1810189') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-bc1d0b.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1416980', '2649614', '2618677', '3003294404', '3011895410', '3004021229', '1021343', '3008316085', '1810189') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('baxter', 'nucare', 'apl', 'aurobindo', 'hospira', 'pfizer india', 'sandoz', 'b braun', 'pharmacia upjohn')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-42271a.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('baxter', 'nucare', 'apl', 'aurobindo', 'hospira', 'pfizer india', 'sandoz', 'b braun', 'pharmacia upjohn', 'roerig', 'b braun medical', 'american regent') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%potassium%' ORDER BY initiation_date
